learning_outcomes.text: Define current, potential difference and resistance with their units
Apply V = IR to series and parallel circuit problems
Compare how current and voltage behave in series and parallel circuits
Interpret and draw standard circuit diagrams using correct symbols
Explain energy transfer in a circuit and the role of resistance
Follow electrical safety: use only low-voltage cells, never mains

integrative_case: Daniel builds a safe low-voltage lighting model for a dolls' house using only cells and bulbs: he designs series and parallel sections, uses V = IR to choose components, measures current and voltage, and records the no-mains safety rule.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
